verdict.rationale: Cake's own help centre has dedicated articles on connecting Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client to Cake. It also describes what you can do with the Cake MCP: querying shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes from the live cap table. This is a first-party MCP server, though it is explicitly read-only. Missing for 10: write/action capabilities (documented as all read-only), setup and authentication details in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
